statement: This record remains negative evidence on build 26100: the repo did not produce enough supporting proof to promote it into a normal actionable surface.

links.title: VS Code documentation: Default settings reference
links.summary: VS Code documents git.autofetch in its settings reference as the supported control surface for background Git autofetch behavior.

links.title: VS Code documentation: Source Control FAQ
links.summary: The FAQ explicitly says the auto fetch feature can be disabled with the git.autofetch setting.

links.title: KVM ETW summary receipt for DisableGitAutofetch
links.summary: The record also tracks a VS Code settings-file surface, but the bounded 2026-04-24 ETW retry only targeted the legacy registry fallback `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced` / `DisableGitAutofetch`. That retry published host-visible summary and stage receipts, but ETL upload never completed so ingest failed before any normalized bundle reached the repo.

links.title: Guest Ghidra launch receipt for DisableGitAutofetch
links.summary: A same-day guest Ghidra retry for `DisableGitAutofetch` failed in `ensure-admin-shell` before any xref bundle reached the host.
